executiveSummary: Today’s sweep added a fresh, more salary-bearing cluster around Addepto, EPAM, Sii, Spyrosoft, Link Group and Simon-Kucher. The strongest signal is Addepto’s canonical Data Scientist / ML Engineer page with Wrocław plus remote and public B2B bands, followed by a new Wrocław AI/ML Engineer at Spyrosoft, a remote Principal AI Engineer at Link Group, and a remote Senior AI Engineer at Simon-Kucher. The Wrocław board also added new EPAM and Sii cards focused on MLOps and agentic automation.

changes: The previous report was mostly a board-first production-ML burst; today’s run adds a more salary-bearing cluster with better canonical coverage.
Addepto is now the cleanest repeatable signal in the topic because the official page keeps public pay bands and a Wrocław/remote scope while the board shows the related roles.
EPAM and Sii added new Wrocław board cards, but those remain more mirror-driven than the direct employer pages.
Remote Poland expanded with two stronger public pay signals: Link Group and Simon-Kucher.
risks: EPAM and Sii remain board-first here, so location wording and status can still drift quickly.
Remote roles at Link Group and Simon-Kucher are strong signals, but they can still rename, expire, or change pay without much warning.
Addepto now looks stable, but the board mirror may continue to split the family across multiple titles.
recommendedActions: Low-risk action applied: wrote the dated report, updated the topic index, and added a new backlog item for the July 26 cluster.
Next run should re-check Addepto, EPAM, Sii, Spyrosoft, Link Group, and Simon-Kucher for expiry, salary drift, and canonical URL changes.
